title: Vera answers questions in the website editor (where a setting lives, is my site ready to publish) from the editor guide and the draft's facts, writing nothing

source.ref: Owner ask 2026-11-03 16:38Z (Vera should answer any question regarding functions and settings) and direction to keep going 17:47Z; Vera assistants plan /mnt/project-files/vera-assistants-2026-11-03/REPORT.md, phase V1 read tools. Builds on LIVE-2097 and LIVE-2098.

detail:
Owners ask Vera how the editor works and whether the site is ready. She had no map of the editor and could not see the draft's state, so she could only guess. Ship a guide of where each control lives (lib/sites/editor/vera-guide.ts, in the words on screen, checked against shell.tsx by probe) and the draft's facts (pages with section counts and search-description presence, the publish checks, unpublished change labels, published and scheduled state: counts and labels only, never a section's words). The editor sends both with the ask, the server reads the facts by shape and refuses malformed ones, and the model answers in the note from them alone, saying it does not know rather than guessing a menu path. A question proposes no changes and writes nothing.

Shipped: vera-guide.ts, facts on the Vera call, answers in the Vera reply.
